entries.name: DeriveTimelock
entries.description: A timelock with access control. The current minimum delay is 10m.

Executor.description: Executing proposals is only open to all addresses if this resolves to the 0x0 address

entries.name: SpotVault
entries.description: Escrow for the collateral deposited to Derive. It grants the WithdrawalOutbox unlimited allowance for approved tokens.

entries.name: WithdrawalOutbox
entries.description: Pays out withdrawals committed to by proven batches from the SpotVault, subject to USD-denominated per-recipient and global rate limits.

entries.name: VerifiableApp
entries.description: Holds the state root and verifies SP1 validity proofs for each batch. Each proof also commits to a Celestia header range and blob hash-chain, which this contract chains from a stored Celestia anchor and checks for freshness.

submitterStallTimeout.description: Time after which anyone can remove the batch submitter if an L1 action stays unprocessed.

entries.name: OnchainActionManager
entries.description: Entry point for L1 deposits and withdrawal requests. Every action is appended to an accumulator that each proven batch must consume in order.

entries.name: WithdrawFactory
entries.description: Deploys a deterministic escrow per recipient and destination chain. Withdrawals paid to such an escrow are bridged onward by keepers via LayerZero OFT or CCIP.
